comment: Root-owned. Workers read only. collision: none | box | cylinder | trunk (cylinder r=radius, h=height at origin). walkable: top surface is a platform for traversal and candy trails. sockets: required socket_<name> empties. parts: required named child nodes (characters).

assets.brief: 1.1 m child in a plush teal dragon onesie: hood with two tiny cream horns, round face showing (skin, big ink eyes with white highlights, pink cheeks), cream belly, stubby felt wings on the back, a fat bouncy tail, mitten hands, round boots. Holds an orange jack-o'-lantern bucket (glowing face cut, rope handle) in the right hand. Every part is its own object parented to an empty root 'dragon_kid' at the feet; each part's origin sits at its joint (hips for legs, shoulders for arms, neck for head, wing roots, tail base) so the game can animate it procedurally. bucket is a child of arm_r; bucket_candy is a child of bucket (a heap of candy inside it that the game scales from 0 to 1 as it fills).

Unlockable costume: the same kid as a bedsheet ghost (follows the user's 'Five Kids in Halloween Costumes' concept). A white sheet over the head down to the knees, two big black oval eyes high on the sheet, a soft rolled opening framing the kid's face and brown fringe, soft vertical folds and a wavy hem (higher in front, lifted over the bucket), white sleeves with bare hands, black leggings and purple high-top sneakers with a white toe and sole, lilac swoosh and orange laces. No wings or tail (the game adds magic dust on double jumps and hovers, and a wand spin). Rig contract identical to dragon_kid (the game animates every costume with the same code): every part is its own object with its origin at its joint (hips for legs, shoulders for arms, neck for head, pelvis for body) at exactly dragon_kid's joint positions, parented with identity rotation/scale to an empty root at the feet; front = glTF +Z. bucket (the same glowing jack-o'-lantern candy bucket as dragon_kid, rope handle, origin at the grip) is a child of arm_r; bucket_candy (candy heap, origin on the bucket floor, scaled 0..1 in Y by the game) and socket_bucket_light are children of bucket. The kid's own face (big ink eyes, pink cheeks, smile) and bare skin hands show in every costume.

Unlockable costume: the same kid as a black cat (follows the user's 'Five Kids in Halloween Costumes' concept). Black plush onesie with a fluffy hood roll, big pointed ears with pink insides, a purple bow tie with a big gold jingle bell, a grey oval belly patch, black paw mitts with pink paw pads, cat face paint (pink nose, whiskers, a gold star on one cheek), black high-tops with purple collars, an orange strap and a little cat face. tail is a long curling black tail with a small purple bow (the only costume with a tail: the game swings it for the tail spin). Rig contract identical to dragon_kid (the game animates every costume with the same code): every part is its own object with its origin at its joint (hips for legs, shoulders for arms, neck for head, pelvis for body) at exactly dragon_kid's joint positions, parented with identity rotation/scale to an empty root at the feet; front = glTF +Z. bucket (the same glowing jack-o'-lantern candy bucket as dragon_kid, rope handle, origin at the grip) is a child of arm_r; bucket_candy (candy heap, origin on the bucket floor, scaled 0..1 in Y by the game) and socket_bucket_light are children of bucket. The kid's own face (big ink eyes, pink cheeks, smile) and bare skin hands show in every costume.

Big purple hat with a wide wavy brim, a flopped hooked tip, an orange satin band and a big yellow star; loose wavy shoulder-length brown hair in rounded locks; purple dress with an orange ruffle hem, orange cuffs and lapels, a dark belt with a gold buckle, a lilac ribbon bow with a gold star clasp; a purple cape with an orange lining built into the body (no wings); orange-and-purple striped stockings and purple high-tops with a star. The game adds magic dust on double jumps and hovers, and a wand spin. No optional parts (the game adds magic dust on double jumps and hovers, and a wand spin). Classic twist-wrapped candy, about 0.32 m long (chunky, readable from 15 m). Body bubblegum pink with lolly_white stripe, twisted ends. Origin at its centre (it floats).
Same shape as candy_wrapped_pink in candy_mint.
Same shape in candy_grape.
Same shape in candy_lemon.
Chunky chocolate bar 0.42 m long, half unwrapped: wrapper_red foil sleeve, choco squares exposed, foil_silver edge. Origin at centre.
Giant swirl lollipop, disc 0.5 m across on a lolly_white stick, swirl of candy_cherry / lolly_white / candy_lemon. Origin at disc centre.
Full-size prize bar 0.6 m long in foil_gold wrapper with glow_candy_gold band so it glows. Origin at centre.
Same shape as candy_wrapped_pink (v3 round ball, bow-tie fans) in candy_orange with candy_orange_light fans. The concept's most common wrapped candy. Origin at its centre (it floats).
Chunky classic candy corn about 0.3 m tall standing tip up: candy_corn_yellow base, candy_orange middle, candy_corn_white tip, lighter highlight column. Origin at its centre (it floats).
Plump squat pumpkin 0.6 m wide, 0.45 m tall, 8 soft lobes, curly stem. Readable ridges.
Taller pumpkin 0.5 m wide, 0.6 m tall, pumpkin_light tone with pumpkin_dark grooves.
Little pie pumpkin 0.3 m wide, deep pumpkin_dark orange, chunky stem.
Cluster of 4-5 small gourds (gourd_green, gourd_yellow, gourd_white, warty) about 0.5 m across.

Carved pumpkin 0.55 m wide with a big happy face: triangle eyes, wide smile. Carved holes are inset faces painted glow_jack (flickering orange glow), rims painted pumpkin_dark. Face points -Y (front). socket_light sits inside at the candle.
As jackolantern_happy but winking (one crescent eye) with a cheeky grin.
Round surprised eyes and an O mouth. Taller pumpkin.
Big friendly grin with two square teeth. Use glow_jack_hot for the mouth.
Sleepy closed-crescent eyes and small smile, squat pumpkin.
Prize giant pumpkin 1.8 m wide, 1.2 m tall, slightly lopsided, big curly stem, a blue first-prize ribbon rosette (quilt_blue) pinned on front. A platform you can stand on.
Rectangular bale 1.1 x 0.6 x 0.55 m (L x W x H), rounded edges, two rope bands, straw tufts. Main platform helper: top must be flat-ish.
Round bale standing upright on its flat end, 1.2 m diameter, 1.0 m tall, spiral on top. Walkable.

Friendly scarecrow 1.9 m tall on a wooden post: burlap-sack face (cardboard tone) with stitched smile, button eyes, floppy witch-free straw hat, flannel_red shirt with patches, denim overalls, straw poking from cuffs, arms out on a crossbar. Cute, never creepy.
Bundle of dried corn stalks tied with rope, 1.8 m tall, straw / straw_dark leaves, splayed top.
Little hay wagon 2.4 x 1.3 m, bed 0.7 m high, metal_red sides, four chunky wheels, hay heap in back. Walkable bed.
Wooden wheelbarrow with one front wheel, holding three small pumpkins.
Wooden apple crate 0.7 m cube, slatted, rounded edges. Platform helper.
Wooden barrel 0.6 m wide, 0.85 m tall, iron hoops. Platform helper.
Oversized sunflower 2.4 m tall, head 0.9 m across facing -Y and tilted slightly down, big leaves on the stalk.
Mound of autumn leaves 1.4 m across, 0.4 m high, mixed maple_red / maple_orange / golden_leaf faceted leaf chips.
Flat ground decal-like patch of curly pumpkin vines with big leaves, 1.6 m across, under 0.2 m high. Used around pumpkins in patches.

Autumn maple about 5.6 m tall: dark curvy bark trunk with root flare forking into limbs hidden in a full, rounded crown (batch02 v2 crown form: ~20 lobes bulging out and down to ~3 m) skinned with ~725 small serrated maple leaf cards over a dark inner shell of larger cards and a shadow filler core; maroon / crimson / red with scarlet tips. socket_branch on a low strong branch (about 2.6 m up, offset 1 m) for swings and lantern strings.
Variant: about 5.2 m, wide full round crown of maple leaf cards in umber / rust / burnt amber / orange with tangerine tips.
Variant: about 6 m, taller oval full crown of maple leaf cards in ochre / burnt amber / amber with golden tips and a few orange and rust accents.
Round leafy shrub about 1.1 m wide, 0.85 m tall: dark core lumps covered by ~380 small pointed leaf cards (14 cm) in hedge_dark / hedge / vine with moss tips on top, a sprinkle of tiny cream flowers.
Classic rounded-top mailbox on a wooden post, 1.2 m tall, red flag up. Box colour mailbox_black (game may vary).
Old-fashioned street lamp 3.4 m tall, lamp_black, curly bracket, lantern head with glow_lamp glass. socket_light at the glass.
Round paper lantern 0.35 m, glow_lantern body with dark ribs, hangs from socket_hang at its top (origin at socket_hang).

Wall-mounted porch lantern 0.5 m tall: wall plate, scroll arm, four-sided hanging lantern with two-tone glowing panes (glow_lantern rim, glow_lamp core) and wide flared roof. Origin at the wall mount, it sticks out toward -Y; socket_light at the glass centre.
Tiny round party bulb 0.1 m in glow_lantern, origin at top. Instanced along string lights by the game.
Wooden rocking chair with a folded quilt (quilt_blue / quilt_yellow), facing -Y.
Garden bench 1.5 m, wood slats, iron legs.
Kids' A-frame swing set 2.6 m wide, 2.2 m tall, metal_blue frame, two swings with metal_red seats. Top bar walkable.
Terracotta pot 0.5 m with orange mums (maple_orange / golden_leaf blobs).
Puffy inflatable ghost 2 m tall, ghost_white, round ink eyes and open happy mouth, little arms up, slightly saggy.
Inflatable black cat 1.8 m tall sitting, cat_black with cat_orange eyes, wearing a witch_purple witch hat.
Round iron cauldron 1 m wide on three stubby legs, bubbling glow_magic_teal potion with big bubble blobs on top.

Decorative parked car: rounded retro bubble hatchback ~3.6 x 1.7 x 1.5 m, teal body (house_teal) with a cream roof, recessed dark glass with chrome window reveals and highlight streaks, chunky whitewall wheels in crisp arches with dark wells, bug-eye headlights, smiling oval grille, wrap-around chrome bumpers, door seams/handles/mirrors, 'BOO' plates and a jack-o'-lantern antenna topper. Front faces -Y (Godot +Z), origin at the ground centre, flat roof is a platform. Lamps unlit.
Chunky cute storm cloud puff cluster about 14 m long, flat-ish bottom, 5-7 overlapping faceted blobs, roof_slate colour. Origin at its centre.
Variant cloud 10 m, rounder.
Variant cloud 18 m, long and lumpy.
Cute round bat 0.5 m wingspan, charcoal, with wing_l / wing_r child objects (origin at the shoulder) so the game can flap them.

Mounded orange chrysanthemum bush ~0.5 x 0.4 m: dense small star-petalled heads (mum_orange, amber centres) over a leafy hedge mound, pointed leaves round the base. Flower beds along fences, planters, porch steps.
Purple mum bush ~0.5 x 0.4 m (wrapper_purple heads, yellow centres), same build as mums_orange.
White mum bush ~0.5 x 0.4 m (ghost_white heads, yellow centres), same build as mums_orange.

Raised brick planter 2.0 x 0.9 x 0.55 m (X long): brick walls, stone cap course, soil, planted with mums and two small pumpkins. Cap/soil top is flat at 0.55 m; plants rise above it (collision_top caps the box collision at the cap).
Square brick fence pillar 0.45 x 0.45 x 1.1 m with a stepped stone cap; flat walkable top, socket_top at the cap centre for a cat, lantern or pumpkin.
Friendly white sheet-ghost porch decoration ~0.9 m tall on a little wooden stand: soft cloth folds, wavy hem, stubby arms, black oval eyes, small open smile, pink cheeks. Faces -Y.
Cute black cat sitting, ~0.35 m tall, big glowing yellow-green eyes (glow_firefly), pink inner ears, tail curled up. Faces -Y. Sits on pillars, porch steps, fences.
Woods conifer about 7.5 m tall: short visible dark trunk, soft drooping layered tiers with jagged needle-clump fringes, deep pine greens with lighter tips.
Variant: taller (about 9.5 m), slimmer conifer with more tiers, slightly leaning tip.

About 1.25 x 1.25 m patch of 6 big flat maple leaves (22-32 cm) spread loosely on the ground with slight curl, mixed crimson / orange / gold / rust. Scatter at random yaw over streets, sidewalks and lawns.
One 14 cm maple leaf with a slight curl, origin at its centre, for scattering with random rotation.

Tiny glowing jack-o'-lantern bulb 0.14 m for porch string lights: ribbed glow_jack_shell globe with a glow_jack_hot carved face toward -Y, green stem and black lamp socket. Origin at the top of the socket (the wire hang point); socket_light at the globe centre. Instanced along sagging wires.

Felt bunting pennant 0.28 m wide x 0.34 m tall, banner_orange, slight cloth wave, double-sided geometry (no alpha). Origin at the top-centre hang point where the cord runs through the rolled hem; the cord runs along X.
As bunting_flag_orange in banner_purple.
As bunting_flag_orange in bunting_cream with a small black bat silhouette on both faces.

Autumn door wreath 0.6 m across: dark twig ring covered in orange/gold/rust leaves, red and purple berries and a puffy banner_purple bow at the bottom. Origin at the back centre (touches the door), front faces -Y; centre of the ring is at the origin height.

Pumpkin Hopper: plump 0.9 m jack-o'-lantern imp with a carved glowing grin, curly stem and leaf, stubby root feet; part_a/part_b are vine arms with leaf hands (pivots at its sides, swing around X). Empty root 'monster_pumpkin' at the ground under the monster's centre, children 'body' (origin = root), 'part_a', 'part_b' (origin at the joint). Faces glTF +Z. Parts have identity rotation; the game swings them around their origin.

Bat: round violet felt body (centre at the origin: it flies, so it floats), big ears, glowing amber eyes, tiny fangs; part_a/part_b are scalloped membrane wings (pivots at the shoulders, flap around Z). Parts have identity rotation; the game swings them around their origin.

Empty root 'monster_scarecrow' at the ground under the monster's centre, children 'body' (origin = root), 'part_a', 'part_b' (origin at the joint). Faces glTF +Z. Parts have identity rotation; the game swings them around their origin.

Empty root 'monster_toadstool' at the ground under the monster's centre, children 'body' (origin = root), 'part_a', 'part_b' (origin at the joint). Faces glTF +Z. Parts have identity rotation; the game swings them around their origin.
Cracked Pumpkin: giant dark pumpkin split by a glowing crack, vines and baby pumpkins sprawling out. ~2.4 m wide, 1.7 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.

Bat Belfry: crooked little bell tower on a post, plum shingled roof, purple-glowing windows, sleeping bats under the eaves. ~3.3 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.

Crooked Graves: fresh dirt mound with three crooked mossy headstones carrying teal-glowing runes, a bony hand and bones. ~2 m wide, 1.4 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.
Haunted Lantern: tall curly iron lantern post burning ghost-purple with a little ghost face in the flame. ~3.3 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.

Candy-Corn Hive: giant squat glossy candy corn in the gremlin's bands (yellow base, orange middle, white tip with its curl), cracked open at the front (+Z) into a dark burrow where glowing eyes and fangs peek out, sitting in heaps of normal candy-corn kernels. ~2 m wide, 1.6 m tall; main body 0.8 m ground radius. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.
Sarcophagus: upright painted sarcophagus with its gold lid ajar, warm glow inside, bandages trailing out. ~2.2 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.
Bubbling Cauldron: fat black cauldron on embers, glowing green goo bubbling over and dripping down. ~1.9 m wide, 1.2 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.

Crow Post: tall crooked crossbar post with three plump glowing-eyed crows, a tattered flag and a hanging jack-o'-lantern. ~3.4 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.
Web Nest: dome of web strands over a dark hole with glowing purple egg sacs and a dangling spiderling. ~2.2 m wide, 1.5 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.
Fairy Ring: a toadstool cottage with a glowing door and window inside a ring of purple glowing toadstools. ~2.6 m wide, 1.2 m tall. Monster spawner (destructible target). Origin at the ground centre.

Travel gate pad + post (teleport point). Round runed flagstone pad 2.9 m across, 0.22 m tall, walkable top, mossy fieldstone skirt, carved (unlit) rune grooves; stone pillar with a wrought-iron crook post (~3.4 m) whose hook sits over (-0.15, 0, 0) at about 3.1 m. No glow cells: every glowing part lives in travel_gate_lantern. Origin at the pad centre on the ground.

Glowing half of the travel gate, in the same space as travel_gate_base (drop both at the same transform): big hexagonal hanging lantern centred at Godot (-0.15, 2.55, 0) with glow_magic_teal panes, plus the teal rune inlays on the pad top (channel ring, 8 runes, centre star) and on the footing stones. The game dims it while the area is locked (glow_boost).

Candy shop cart, front faces -Y (Godot +Z): painted wooden cart ~2.3 m wide with wagon wheels, candy-cane posts, pink/white striped awning with scalloped valance (top ~2.6 m), a blank sign board for the game's Label3D, candy jars, lollipops, pumpkins, a hanging lantern, and a flat round doormat centred at Godot (0, 0, 1.25). Origin at the ground centre under the cart body.

Round backyard trampoline ~3.75 m across (pad outer radius 1.87 m), origin at ground centre. Dark plum woven mat, top exactly 0.85 m, printed with a big jack-o'-lantern inside an orange target ring and faint bats; bone-stitched purple border; ring of 40 steel springs; puffy orange safety pad (alternating pumpkin panels, purple skirt) rising ~6 cm above the mat; 6 curved steel W-legs; small purple-step ladder on the front-right (-62 deg, reaches r 2.2 m). No enclosure net. bounce = launch speed for gameplay.

Mini fitness rebounder ~1.18 m across, origin at ground centre. Black woven mat, top exactly 0.28 m, with a bold lemon star inside a lemon ring; painted steel spring band; bright violet padded rim (darker purple skirt) rising ~3 cm above the mat; six stubby splayed steel legs with rubber feet. bounce = launch speed for gameplay.

Decorative parked car: retro station wagon ~4.2 x 1.8 x 1.6 m, cherry-red body (metal_red) with faux-wood side panels in cream frames, cream roof with a low roof rack carrying a suitcase and two pumpkins (one a glowing jack; cargo tops out ~0.22 m above the roof), recessed dark glass with chrome reveals, whitewall wheels, round lamps, chrome bumpers. Front faces -Y (Godot +Z), origin at the ground centre, roof is a platform. Lamps unlit.

Decorative parked car: small vintage pickup ~4.0 x 1.8 x 1.6 m, sunny yellow body (quilt_yellow) with a white cab roof, long rounded bonnet with a chrome grille, open plank-floored bed holding a hay bale, pumpkins and a carved jack-o'-lantern (glow face) sitting on the bale. Front faces -Y (Godot +Z), origin at the ground centre, cab roof is the highest platform. Lamps unlit.

Thorn vine bramble knot (infestation the player burns with fireballs; replaces C++ build_vine): thick dark-green bark vine stems corkscrewing up out of the ground and arching over into curled tips, roots knotting into the ground, studded with many bone-white spines (cream tips) pointing outward, a few small leaves and two small glowing purple buds. ~2.2 m across, ~2.5 m tall. Single merged mesh, origin at the ground centre. Silhouette: corkscrew spire - four stems twisted into one rope trunk that splits into crozier hooks at staggered heights.

Thorn vine bramble knot (infestation the player burns with fireballs; replaces C++ build_vine): thick dark-green bark vine stems corkscrewing up out of the ground and arching over into curled tips, roots knotting into the ground, studded with many bone-white spines (cream tips) pointing outward, a few small leaves and two small glowing purple buds. ~2.2 m across, ~2.5 m tall. Single merged mesh, origin at the ground centre. Silhouette: bramble dome - three arches diving back into the ground, crossing over a central curled spire.

Thorn vine bramble knot (infestation the player burns with fireballs; replaces C++ build_vine): thick dark-green bark vine stems corkscrewing up out of the ground and arching over into curled tips, roots knotting into the ground, studded with many bone-white spines (cream tips) pointing outward, a few small leaves and two small glowing purple buds. ~2.2 m across, ~2.5 m tall. Single merged mesh, origin at the ground centre. Silhouette: shepherd's crook - one fat stem leaning up into a big top curl, companion stems wound round it curling the other way.

Thorn nest (replaces the C++ ThornVine heart: the big knot + purple blob): a huge gnarled root mass ~4.2 m across x ~3.6 m tall. Twisted rope-like bark roots rise from the ground and coil into a cage/crown of outward fiddlehead curls over a root cradle, big bone-white spines everywhere, smaller creeping vines spill out over the ground. The cage opens at the front (glTF +Z) on a glowing heart. Empty root 'thorn_root_mass' (origin at the ground centre) with two mesh children: 'roots' (origin = root; everything except the heart) and 'heart' (glow_purple seed-heart ~1.3 m across, cupped by dark veined plum husk petals; its origin is the heart centre at (0, 1.5, 0) game coordinates, identity rotation) so the game can pulse its scale and glow on its own.
Round twist-wrapped sweet in raspberry with white polka dots and pale pink fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet in aqua printed with little purple bats, mint fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet in purple printed with orange pumpkins, lilac fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Two-tone twist-wrapped sweet: lime half and cobalt half, matching fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Two-tone twist-wrapped sweet: cherry half and lemon half, matching fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet in sky blue printed with lemon stars. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet in peach with raspberry rings, lemon fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet with a mint and white checker wrapper. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
Round twist-wrapped sweet in orange printed with white ghosts, lemon fans. About 0.32 m across; origin at its centre (it floats and spins).
